title: Rav Yirmeyah bar Acha
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He speaks in Rav’s name in [Chullin 51b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.51b.9) and disputes Rav Chisda there. Hyman calls this a textual error and proposes the reading cited in Dikdukei Soferim and found by the Rosh: Rav Sheshet said in the name of R’ Yirmeyah bar Abba, who spoke in Rav’s name; Rav Chisda disputes Rav Sheshet.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: The heading has bar Acha. Hyman proposes a different chain: Rav Sheshet→R’ Yirmeyah bar Abba→Rav, with Rav Chisda disagreeing with Rav Sheshet. The William Davidson vocalized text of Chullin 51b instead has Rav Yirmeyah bar Acha→Rav, then Rav Chisda. It supports the cited current reading, not Hyman’s alternate chain.

The consulted [Rosh](https://www.sefaria.org/Rosh_on_Chullin.3.36.1) quotes the chain as Rav Huna bar Rav Yehudah in the name of Rav Sheshet, in the name of Yirmeyah, in the name of Rav. This digital text gives Yirmeyah without a patronymic. Hyman gives bar Abba and also cites Dikdukei Soferim. The two occurrences of דב in the supplied Hebrew are read contextually as רב.
The alternate chain’s א״ר title is rendered R' rather than Rabbi or Rav. Hyman’s fully written Rav titles elsewhere are retained; the two patronymics are not harmonized.
